products.name: Livmarli (maralixibat)
products.description: A novel, orally administered, minimally-absorbed ileal bile acid transporter (IBAT) inhibitor for the treatment of cholestatic pruritus in patients with Alagille syndrome (ALGS), progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis (PFIC), and potentially other rare cholestatic conditions. Manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis and delivered as an oral solution, commercialized directly and via partners globally.

products.name: Cholbam (cholic acid)
products.description: An orally administered cholic acid capsule approved for the treatment of bile acid synthesis disorders due to single enzyme defects and for adjunctive treatment of peroxisomal disorders, including PBD-ZSD. Manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis and distributed through specialty pharmacy channels.

products.name: Ctexli (chenodiol)
products.description: An orally administered chenodeoxycholic acid (chenodiol) tablet, approved for the treatment of cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis (CTX). Manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis and distributed through specialty pharmacy channels.

products.name: Volixibat (in development)
products.description: A novel, oral, minimally-absorbed IBAT inhibitor in clinical development for the treatment of adult patients with cholestatic liver diseases, specifically primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) and primary biliary cholangitis (PBC). Manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis, not yet approved or commercialized.

products.name: Brelovitug (in development)
products.description: A fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting hepatitis B surface antigen, in clinical development for the treatment of chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection. Manufactured using proprietary cell line technology and evaluated in global clinical trials.

products.name: MRM-3379 (in development)
products.description: A novel, oral, CNS-penetrant PDE4D inhibitor in clinical development for the treatment of fragile X syndrome (FXS), a rare genetic neurocognitive disorder. Manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis and currently in Phase 2 clinical trials.

products.name: Hepatitis C Antiviral Therapy (Bemnifosbuvir and Ruzasvir Regimen)
products.description: An investigational, orally administered fixed-dose combination tablet of bemnifosbuvir (a nucleotide analog NS5B polymerase inhibitor) and ruzasvir (a pan-genotypic NS5A inhibitor) developed for the treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. The regimen is manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis and formulation, and is intended for commercial sale upon regulatory approval.

products.name: Hepatitis E Antiviral Therapy (AT-587)
products.description: An investigational, orally administered nucleotide analog prodrug (AT-587) developed for the treatment of chronic hepatitis E virus (HEV) infection, particularly in immunocompromised patients. The product is synthesized and formulated for oral delivery, with clinical development and commercial supply planned upon regulatory approval.

products.name: Bauxite
products.description: Raw bauxite ore is mined from company-operated and joint venture mines and sold to third-party customers as well as supplied internally for alumina refining. Mining requires significant physical infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Alumina
products.description: Alumina is produced by refining bauxite ore using the Bayer process at large-scale refineries and is sold as smelter grade (for aluminum production) and non-metallurgical grade (for industrial chemical products) to global customers. Production is capital-intensive and highly regulated.

products.name: Primary Aluminum Products
products.description: Molten primary aluminum is produced by smelting alumina in electrolysis cells and then cast into commodity grade ingots (t-bar, sow, standard ingot) or value-add ingot products (foundry, billet, rod, slab) for sale to external customers in various industries. Production is energy-intensive and requires specialized smelting and casting facilities.

products.name: Energy Sales
products.description: Alcoa owns and operates hydroelectric and coal-fired power generation assets, selling excess electricity to external customers in Brazil and the United States. Energy is produced using regulated infrastructure and is sold under various contract structures.

products.name: Low-Carbon and Recycled Aluminum and Alumina (Sustana® Brand)
products.description: Alcoa offers low-carbon aluminum (EcoLum®), recycled-content aluminum (EcoDura®), and low-carbon alumina (EcoSource®) under the Sustana® brand, produced using renewable energy and/or recycled materials, targeting customers seeking sustainable materials. Production leverages existing smelting and refining infrastructure with additional sustainability measures.

products.name: ELYSIS Carbon-Free Aluminum
products.description: Through the ELYSIS joint venture, Alcoa is developing and commercializing aluminum produced using inert anode technology, which eliminates direct greenhouse gas emissions from the smelting process. Early-stage commercial quantities are sold to select customers, with plans for large-scale commercialization.

products.name: Fulfillment
products.description: A cloud-based solution that automates and streamlines supply chain operations by enabling trading partners to send and receive order data, manage invoicing, and recover revenue through fully automated processes. Delivered as a full-service platform integrated with customers' existing systems.

products.name: Analytics
products.description: A cloud-based analytics platform that acquires, cleanses, normalizes, and delivers sell-through and supply chain data, providing pre-built dashboards and custom reports to help customers optimize product performance, forecasting, pricing, and inventory management. Delivered digitally and integrates with existing tools.

products.name: Assortment
products.description: A digital product that automates the communication and translation of item data, attributes, and hierarchies across all sales channels, enabling accurate and efficient product information management for trading partners. Delivered via the cloud network.

products.name: Relationship Management
products.description: A cloud-based solution that accelerates supply chain digitization and improves collaboration between organizations and their suppliers through onboarding programs, change management, and supplier score carding. Delivered as a managed service.

products.name: Professional Services and Testing/Certification
products.description: One-time services including professional consulting, onboarding, and testing/certification to support customer integration and compliance with supply chain requirements. Delivered by in-person or remote human labor.

products.name: Amazon Seller Tools (via Carbon6 acquisition)
products.description: Software tools for Amazon sellers, including specialized offerings for revenue recovery for both first-party and third-party suppliers. Delivered digitally as SaaS products.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution and sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers via a regulated pipeline network. Requires regulated infrastructure, physical delivery, and ongoing maintenance of distribution systems.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of customer-owned natural gas for industrial users utilizing the company's pipeline infrastructure. Involves regulated infrastructure and physical delivery without sale of the commodity itself.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production and Delivery
products.description: Production and delivery of renewable natural gas through a dedicated RNG facility, integrated into the existing distribution system. Involves physical production and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Discovery and Safety Assessment Services
products.description: Comprehensive contract research services supporting drug and medical device discovery and development, including bioanalytical method development, in vivo pharmacology, exploratory pharmacokinetics and toxicology, non-clinical toxicology and pathology, stability testing, drug metabolism, and clinical bioanalysis. Delivered through laboratory-based human expertise and regulated infrastructure, these services are provided to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device clients.

products.name: Research Models (Laboratory Animals)
products.description: Production and global sale of purpose-bred laboratory animal models, including small animals (mice, rats) and large animals (non-human primates, rabbits), for use in scientific research and drug development. Animals are bred and maintained in controlled, bio-secure facilities to ensure health and genetic quality, and are supplied to pharmaceutical, academic, and government clients.

products.name: Laboratory Animal Diet, Bedding, and Enrichment Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of laboratory animal diets, bedding, and enrichment products under the Teklad brand, including both standard and custom formulations. Products are produced in ISO-certified facilities and distributed globally through company-managed networks, supporting animal research and husbandry.

products.name: Research Model Services
products.description: Specialized services supporting the use of research models, including surgical modifications, contract breeding, colony management, health monitoring, creation of new transgenic models, quarantine, cryopreservation, rederivation, revitalization, antibody development, and transportation. Delivered by skilled personnel at dedicated facilities for research clients.

products.name: Archiving Services
products.description: Climate-controlled storage and archiving of clients’ data, samples, and specimens at DSA facilities, ensuring regulatory compliance and data integrity for research and development projects.

products.name: Computational and Genetic Toxicology Services
products.description: Services supporting new approach methodologies (NAMs) for drug safety, including computational toxicology, genetic toxicology in bacteria and mammalian cells, and proteomic pathway profiling. These are laboratory and data-driven services supporting regulatory and scientific needs for alternatives to animal testing.

products.name: Packaged Coffee Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed branded coffee products, including roast and ground coffee, single-serve K-Cup pods, and premium coffee, primarily sold through retail and foodservice channels. Production involves sourcing green coffee beans, roasting, packaging, and distribution.

products.name: Sweet Baked Goods
products.description: Manufactured and marketed branded sweet baked snacks such as snack cakes, donuts, muffins, and pies, distributed through retail, convenience, and foodservice channels. Production requires large-scale baking, packaging, and logistics.

products.name: Frozen Handheld Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed frozen handheld food items, primarily crustless sandwiches and snacks, sold through retail and foodservice channels. Production involves assembly, freezing, packaging, and distribution.

products.name: Peanut Butter and Specialty Spreads
products.description: Manufactured and marketed branded peanut butter and specialty spreads, including nut butters and flavored spreads, sold through retail and foodservice channels. Production involves processing peanuts and other ingredients, packaging, and distribution.

products.name: Fruit Spreads, Toppings, and Syrups
products.description: Manufactured and marketed branded fruit spreads, jams, jellies, toppings, and syrups, sold through retail and foodservice channels. Production involves fruit processing, cooking, packaging, and distribution.

products.name: Pet Food and Pet Snacks
products.description: Manufactured and marketed branded cat food and pet snacks, including dry cat food and dog treats, sold through retail and specialty pet channels. Production involves formulation, extrusion or baking, packaging, and distribution.

products.name: Baking Mixes and Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured and marketed branded baking mixes and ingredients, such as flour and baking aids, sold primarily through retail channels. Production involves blending, packaging, and distribution of dry ingredients.

products.name: Portion Control Foodservice Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed portion control foodservice products, including single-serve spreads and condiments, distributed to foodservice operators and institutions. Production involves portioning, packaging, and distribution.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution
products.description: Distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers through regulated utility infrastructure, including metered and bulk delivery, primarily in Delaware, Maryland, and Florida. Service is provided via pipelines and underground systems, with rates regulated by state public service commissions.

products.name: Natural Gas Transmission
products.description: Transmission of natural gas via interstate and intrastate pipelines to utilities, industrial, and commercial customers, including firm transportation and storage services. Operations are regulated by FERC or negotiated rates, and include pipeline expansions and capacity contracts.

products.name: Electric Distribution
products.description: Distribution of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Florida through regulated utility infrastructure. Electricity is purchased wholesale and delivered via company-owned distribution networks, with rates regulated by the Florida PSC.

products.name: Propane Distribution and Services
products.description: Sale and delivery of propane to residential, commercial, wholesale, and AutoGas customers, including bulk and metered delivery, underground propane distribution systems, and vehicle conversion/fueling infrastructure. Propane is transported from bulk storage facilities to customer locations.

products.name: Mobile Compressed Natural Gas (CNG), LNG, and RNG Transport Services
products.description: Provision of mobile CNG, LNG, and RNG transport and virtual pipeline solutions, including temporary, emergency, and specialized gas delivery services for utilities, pipelines, and RNG producers. Services are delivered using a fleet of trailers, mobile compression equipment, and patented regulator systems.

products.name: Unregulated Natural Gas Transmission and Supply
products.description: Ownership and operation of unregulated natural gas pipeline systems, supplying gas to utilities and marketers under long-term agreements, and providing gas gathering and processing services. Includes integration of renewable natural gas (RNG) from landfill and agricultural sources into the pipeline system.

products.name: Energy Generation (Electricity and Steam)
products.description: Generation of electricity and steam at a combined heat and power (CHP) plant, powered by natural gas, with electricity sold to the company's electric distribution operation and steam sold to industrial customers under long-term contracts.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production and Sustainable Investments
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of renewable natural gas production facilities, including anaerobic digestion of agricultural and poultry waste, and related transportation assets to bring RNG to market. Includes technology and pilot projects for biogas production.

products.name: Evo Cortical Electrode System
products.description: A thin-film cortical (subdural) electrode system used for temporary (less than 30 days) recording, monitoring, and stimulation on the surface of the brain, primarily for diagnostic and therapeutic procedures in neurological disorders. Manufactured using automated processes and distributed via Zimmer Biomet.

products.name: Evo sEEG Electrode System
products.description: A thin-film depth (stereoelectroencephalography) electrode system for temporary (less than 30 days) subsurface brain recording, monitoring, and stimulation, used in diagnosing and treating epilepsy and other neurological disorders. Requires physician order and is distributed via Zimmer Biomet.

products.name: OneRF Brain Ablation System
products.description: A radiofrequency ablation system for creating lesions in nervous tissue during functional neurosurgical procedures, providing bedside monitoring, mapping, and ablation in a single device. Manufactured for less invasive neurosurgical interventions, distributed via Zimmer Biomet.

products.name: OneRF Trigeminal Nerve (TN) Ablation System
products.description: A minimally invasive radiofrequency ablation system designed for the treatment of trigeminal neuralgia and other pain-related neurological disorders, featuring a multi-contact RF probe for precise localization and ablation of nerve tissue. Commercialized with a limited market release.

products.name: Drug Delivery Electrode Systems (in development)
products.description: Combination devices based on sEEG electrode technology capable of delivering drugs, gene, or cell therapies to the brain while simultaneously recording and stimulating brain activity. Intended for both preclinical research and clinical use, with ongoing development and regulatory pursuit.

products.name: Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) Systems (in development)
products.description: Percutaneously placed thin-film paddle electrode systems for spinal cord stimulation to treat chronic back pain, utilizing scalable contact configurations for precise electrical stimulation. Designed for less invasive implantation by pain management doctors, currently in development.

products.name: Basivertebral Nerve Ablation (BVNA) System (in development)
products.description: A system leveraging ablation technology and multi-contact probes to target the basivertebral nerve for the treatment of chronic low back pain. Designed to increase placement flexibility and improve outcomes compared to existing BVNA systems, currently under development.

products.name: Debt Portfolio Purchasing and Recovery
products.description: The company purchases portfolios of defaulted consumer receivables at deep discounts and manages them by collecting payments from individuals through a combination of direct mail, call centers, digital platforms, and legal action. This business requires significant financial capital, proprietary analytics, and a regulated operational infrastructure.

products.name: Debt Servicing and Portfolio Management Services
products.description: The company provides debt servicing and portfolio management services for non-performing loans, including early stage collections, business process outsourcing, and contingent collections for credit originators. These services are delivered through operational centers and require compliance with complex regulatory frameworks.

products.name: Wholesale Electricity Sales
products.description: Talen generates electricity from a diverse fleet of nuclear, natural gas, coal, and oil-fired power plants and sells this electricity into wholesale U.S. power markets, primarily PJM and WECC, through auctions, contracts, and spot market sales. This involves large-scale physical generation and delivery of power via regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Capacity Sales
products.description: Talen sells generation capacity, which is the commitment to provide available power, into capacity markets such as PJM through forward auctions, bilateral contracts, and reliability arrangements. This product is delivered via regulated market mechanisms and is critical for grid reliability.

products.name: Ancillary Services
products.description: Talen provides ancillary services, such as frequency regulation and reserve power, to support grid stability and reliability. These services are sold into wholesale markets and require operational flexibility and compliance with grid operator requirements.

products.name: Long-Term Power Supply Contracts
products.description: Talen enters into long-term, fixed-price power purchase agreements (PPAs) with large customers, such as AWS, to supply carbon-free or reliable power directly from its generation assets. These contracts are structured to deliver large volumes of power over extended periods, often at premium prices, and require physical generation and delivery infrastructure.

products.name: Reliability Must-Run (RMR) Services
products.description: Talen operates certain power plants under Reliability Must-Run (RMR) agreements, providing grid reliability services in exchange for fixed payments. These arrangements require continued operation of specific facilities to maintain local grid stability until transmission upgrades are completed.

products.name: Consumer Electric Vehicles
products.description: Rivian designs, manufactures, and sells electric pickup trucks (R1T), SUVs (R1S), and plans to launch midsize SUVs and crossovers (R2, R3, R3X) using vertically integrated technology and direct-to-consumer sales. Vehicles are produced in US factories and delivered to customers, with ongoing software updates and enhancements provided digitally.

products.name: Commercial Electric Vehicles
products.description: Rivian manufactures and sells electric commercial vans, including the Electric Delivery Van (EDV) platform, primarily for fleet customers such as Amazon. These vehicles are designed for large-scale production, fleet management, and last-mile delivery, with features tailored for commercial use and decarbonization goals.

products.name: Automotive Regulatory Credits
products.description: Rivian earns and sells tradable regulatory credits related to zero-emission vehicles, greenhouse gas, fuel economy, and clean fuel standards in the US and Canada. These credits are sold to other regulated entities for compliance purposes.

products.name: Vehicle Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Rivian provides technology-enabled vehicle repair and maintenance services through a network of physical service centers and mobile service vehicles, as well as partnerships with collision centers and third-party providers, supplying parts and support for Rivian vehicles.

products.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Network and Solutions
products.description: Rivian designs, manufactures, and operates the Rivian Adventure Network of Direct Current fast chargers across North America, providing charging solutions for Rivian and non-Rivian EVs. The network is designed for convenience, clean energy delivery, and is open to most EVs to maximize utilization.

products.name: Software Subscriptions and Digital Services
products.description: Rivian offers software subscriptions for both consumer and commercial vehicles, including connectivity features, over-the-air updates, enhanced media, security (Connect+), and proprietary fleet management (FleetOS) for commercial customers. These digital services are delivered via cloud-based platforms and recurring payments.

products.name: Advanced Driver Assistance and Autonomy Features (Autonomy+)
products.description: Rivian develops and sells advanced driver assistance features (Autonomy+), including hands-free driving and plans for higher-level autonomy, delivered via over-the-air updates and available as one-time or subscription purchases for vehicle owners.

products.name: Used Vehicle Sales and Remarketing
products.description: Rivian buys back and resells used Rivian vehicles directly to customers through its website, offering trade-in and remarketing services as part of the ownership lifecycle.

products.name: Vehicle Accessories and Adventure Gear
products.description: Rivian sells a range of vehicle and non-vehicle accessories, including adventure gear, through its Rivian Gear Shop, complementing its vehicle offerings and enhancing customer experience.

products.name: Vehicle Financing and Insurance Services
products.description: Rivian offers vehicle financing and insurance products to customers in partnership with third parties, integrated into the Rivian purchase process to facilitate vehicle ownership.

products.name: Consumables
products.description: A broad range of regularly replaced household consumable goods, including health and beauty aids, food, candy, beverages, pet food and treats, laundry products, cleaning supplies, floor care, and paper goods, sourced as closeouts and excess inventory and sold through physical retail stores.

products.name: Home Products
products.description: Brand name and private label products for use in and around the home, including housewares, kitchen items, home décor, furniture, household essentials, and home maintenance and utility items, sourced as closeouts and excess inventory and sold in-store.

products.name: Seasonal Products
products.description: A rotating assortment of products tied to specific seasons, holidays, or events, such as patio furniture, air conditioners, fans, space heaters, toys, lawn and garden products, outdoor items, holiday décor, gifts, and decorations, sourced opportunistically and sold in-store.

products.name: General Merchandise (Other)
products.description: A diverse mix of closeout and excess inventory items not classified as consumables, home, or seasonal, including books, stationery, small electronics and accessories, clothing, sporting goods, pet products, automotive products, luggage, and other general merchandise, sold through physical stores.

products.name: Home and Alternate Site Infusion Services
products.description: Comprehensive infusion therapy services provided in patients' homes or at ambulatory infusion suites, including clinical management, nursing support, care coordination, and administration of pharmaceuticals for complex and chronic medical conditions. Delivered through a national network of pharmacies and clinicians, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person clinical labor.

products.name: Infusion Pharmacy Services
products.description: Provision and distribution of pharmaceuticals and complex compounded solutions for intravenous delivery, including medication compounding, dispensing, and delivery to patients' homes or alternate sites. Requires licensed pharmacy operations, pharmaceutical procurement, and compliance with compounding standards.

products.name: Specialty Infusion Therapies
products.description: Administration and management of specialized infusion therapies for specific conditions, including anti-infectives, nutrition support, immunoglobulin therapy, chronic inflammatory disorders, neurological disorders, bleeding disorders, women’s health, heart failure, and other complex conditions. Delivered by multidisciplinary clinical teams with disease-specific expertise.

products.name: Infusion Nursing Services
products.description: Provision of specialized nursing care to support infusion therapies, including in-home administration, clinical monitoring, patient education, and care coordination. Delivered by employed and subcontracted nurses, requiring professional licensure and in-person care.

products.name: Clinical Outcomes and Data Services for Manufacturers
products.description: Provision of clinical outcomes, compliance data, and patient monitoring programs to pharmaceutical manufacturers, supporting product launches and evaluation of therapy effectiveness. Delivered through data collection and reporting infrastructure integrated with clinical services.

products.name: Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) Cancer Therapeutics
products.description: Development and commercialization of next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for oncology, built around proprietary payloads (notably PH1) that target cancer cells via novel mechanisms, including RNA splicing modulation. These are biologic drugs manufactured using advanced chemistry and biology, delivered intravenously, and require regulated clinical development and manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: ADC Out-Licensing and Payload Platform Partnerships
products.description: Out-licensing of rights to specific ADC product candidates (such as AKTX-101) and licensing of proprietary payloads (such as PH1) to biopharmaceutical partners for development of their own ADCs. This is a business-to-business service involving intellectual property transfer and collaborative drug development agreements.

products.name: Legacy Non-Oncology Therapeutics (Out-Licensing)
products.description: Out-licensing of legacy, non-oncology drug assets, including Nomacopan (for rare blood disorders), PAS-Nomacopan (for geographic atrophy), and PHP-303 (for alpha-1 antitrypsin disorder). These are biologic and small molecule drug candidates developed for rare diseases, now offered for external partnership or sale.

products.name: IBSRELA (tenapanor) for IBS-C
products.description: A first-in-class, oral, minimally absorbed NHE3 inhibitor therapy for the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C) in adults. Manufactured as a small molecule drug and delivered via prescription, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: XPHOZAH (tenapanor) for Hyperphosphatemia in CKD Patients on Dialysis
products.description: A first-in-class, oral phosphate absorption inhibitor (NHE3 inhibitor) for reducing serum phosphorus in adults with chronic kidney disease on dialysis who have inadequate response or intolerance to phosphate binders. Manufactured as a small molecule drug and delivered via prescription, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Tenapanor (supplied to partners for ex-U.S. commercialization)
products.description: Supply of tenapanor drug substance or finished product to international partners for commercialization in indications such as hyperphosphatemia and IBS-C. Involves pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution to third-party licensees for sale in their territories.

products.name: Senior Secured Private Debt Investments
products.description: Directly originated senior secured loans and private debt provided to well-established middle-market companies, primarily negotiated directly with borrowers and tailored to each transaction. These are physical financial products requiring significant capital and underwriting expertise, and are delivered through direct lending relationships.

products.name: Customized Middle-Market Financing Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive financing packages for middle-market companies, including first and second lien loans, unitranche structures, revolvers, and mezzanine debt, structured and delivered as one-stop solutions to meet specific borrower needs. These require financial structuring, negotiation, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Equity Co-Investments
products.description: Minority equity investments in portfolio companies, typically structured as non-control positions that provide minority rights. These are negotiated as part of broader financing packages and are delivered through direct investment in company equity.

products.name: Special Situations and Distressed Debt Investments
products.description: Opportunistic investments in stressed and distressed corporate debt instruments, including senior and subordinated loans, mezzanine and payment-in-kind securities, and other forms of subordinated debt. These are complex, negotiated transactions requiring specialized credit analysis and risk management.

products.name: Structured Credit Investments
products.description: Investments in structured credit products such as private asset-backed securities, typically as part of a diversified portfolio. These require specialized financial expertise and are delivered through negotiated transactions or secondary market purchases.

products.name: Syndicated Loan and High Yield Investments
products.description: Investments in syndicated loan opportunities and high yield securities, acquired through participation in broader lending syndicates or secondary market transactions. These are financial products requiring capital allocation and credit analysis.

products.name: Locomotives
products.description: Manufacture and sale of new and modernized diesel-electric and liquid natural gas powered locomotives for freight and passenger rail, requiring large-scale physical manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Locomotive and Railcar Aftermarket Services
products.description: Provision of aftermarket parts, maintenance, modernization, rebuilding, overhauling, remanufacturing, and unit exchange services for locomotives and railcars, delivered through in-person labor and logistics.

products.name: Freight Car Components
products.description: Manufacture and sale of components for freight railcars, including trucks, braking equipment, air compressors, dryers, HVAC systems, heat transfer components, turbochargers, and custom engineered systems, involving physical manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Transit Vehicle Components and Systems
products.description: Manufacture and servicing of components and systems for passenger transit vehicles (trains, subways, light-rail, buses), including braking equipment, HVAC, doors, pantographs, auxiliary power, passenger information systems, and accessibility solutions, requiring regulated manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Rail Control and Signaling Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and installation of rail control and infrastructure products, including electronics, positive train control (PTC) equipment, signaling, and engineering services, delivered through a combination of hardware, software, and field engineering.

products.name: Digital Intelligence Solutions
products.description: Provision of software-enabled solutions for rail and mining industries, including train performance optimization, transport intelligence (IoT hardware/software, analytics), transport logistics, network optimization, and asset performance management, delivered digitally and via integrated hardware/software platforms.

products.name: Nondestructive Testing and Inspection Solutions
products.description: Provision of nondestructive testing, remote visual inspection, and analytical instruments for mission critical assets in rail and industrial markets, involving specialized equipment and digital analytics.

products.name: Marine and Mining Equipment and Components
products.description: Manufacture and sale of engines, electric motors, propulsion systems, and other products for marine and mining applications, leveraging physical manufacturing and engineering expertise.

products.name: Sulfuric Acid Regeneration Services
products.description: Provides end-to-end recycling and regeneration of spent sulfuric acid from refineries, using a network of strategically located manufacturing facilities and logistics assets. The process involves thermal decomposition and conversion into high strength fresh sulfuric acid for reuse in refining alkylation processes. Delivered via barge, rail, truck, or pipeline.

products.name: Virgin Sulfuric Acid Products
products.description: Manufactures high-purity virgin sulfuric acid and derivatives through incineration of sulfur or as a by-product of metal smelting, supplying industrial, mining, water treatment, and chemical production applications. Production occurs at multiple facilities using specialized furnace operations.

products.name: Hazardous and Non-Hazardous Waste Treatment Services
products.description: Provides thermal destruction and treatment services for bulk hazardous and non-hazardous industrial wastes, specializing in sulfur-bearing and acidic materials. The process captures energy and sulfur content for beneficial reuse, supplementing manufacturing processes.

products.name: Catalyst Activation Services (Chem32)
products.description: Offers ex-situ sulfiding and pre-activation services for hydro-processing catalysts used in refining, petrochemical, and environmental processes, utilizing proprietary fixed-bed sulfiding technology. Services are delivered at dedicated facilities for third-party catalysts.

products.name: Specialty Sulfuric Acid Derivatives and Solutions
products.description: Produces and supplies specialty sulfuric acid derivatives such as oleum, aluminum sulfate solution, and ammonium bisulfite solution for industrial, water treatment, and lubricant applications. These products are manufactured at company facilities and delivered to industrial and municipal customers.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, production, and sale of crude oil from operated and non-operated fields in Gabon, Egypt, Cote d'Ivoire, and (prior to divestment) Canada. Involves physical extraction, processing, and delivery of crude oil to customers, governed by production sharing contracts and subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, production, and sale of natural gas, primarily from Canadian assets (prior to divestment) and Cote d'Ivoire. Involves physical extraction, processing, and delivery of natural gas to third-party plants and customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as ethane, propane, butane, and condensates, primarily from Canadian assets (prior to divestment). Involves extraction, processing, and sale of NGLs as separate products.

products.name: UNITY Prenatal Genetic Testing Portfolio
products.description: A suite of non-invasive prenatal tests (NIPT) using single-molecule next-generation sequencing (smNGS) technology to assess fetal risk for recessive conditions, aneuploidies, and fetal antigens from a single maternal blood draw. Tests are processed in specialized, automated clinical laboratories and results are delivered to clinicians within two weeks.

products.name: Northstar Oncology Liquid Biopsy Portfolio
products.description: A portfolio of ultrasensitive, smNGS-based liquid biopsy tests for late-stage solid tumor cancer patients, including tests for therapy selection (Northstar Select) and therapy response monitoring (Northstar Response), performed on blood samples without the need for tissue biopsies. Tests are processed in clinical labs and provide actionable genomic and epigenomic insights to oncologists.

products.name: Northstar PGx and Northstar Select CH Add-on Tests
products.description: Add-on applications for the Northstar Select oncology platform, providing pharmacogenomics (PGx) testing for chemotherapy safety and clonal hematopoiesis (CH) assessment, expanding the clinical utility of the Northstar platform for therapy selection. Delivered as additional analyses on blood samples processed with the Northstar Select test.

products.name: UNITY Fetal Antigen Clinical Trial Assay (CTA)
products.description: A specialized non-invasive prenatal test for fetal antigen status, provided as a companion diagnostic in clinical trials (notably in partnership with Johnson & Johnson for the AZALEA Phase 3 trial), using smNGS technology to determine eligibility for targeted therapies in pregnancies at risk for severe HDFN. Processed in certified clinical labs for trial use.

products.name: Future Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) and Early Cancer Detection Tests (in development)
products.description: Upcoming smNGS-based liquid biopsy tests for minimal residual disease (MRD) detection and early-stage cancer detection, designed to identify trace amounts of tumor DNA post-surgery or at early disease stages, using blood samples and advanced sequencing. Commercial launch expected in 2026 for MRD; early detection test in R&D phase.

products.name: DARE to PLAY Sildenafil Cream
products.description: A topically applied sildenafil cream for female sexual arousal, manufactured under cGMP by a Section 503B outsourcing facility and dispensed via pharmacy, available by prescription as a compounded drug.

products.name: DARE to RECLAIM Estradiol Progesterone Intravaginal Ring
products.description: A non-oral, monthly intravaginal ring delivering bio-identical 17β-estradiol and progesterone for menopausal hormone therapy, manufactured under cGMP and available by prescription as a compounded drug via Section 503B outsourcing facility.

products.name: DARE to RESTORE Vaginal Probiotic Suppositories
products.description: A line of non-prescription vaginal probiotic suppositories, including Flora Sync LF5, designed to support vaginal microbiome balance, manufactured by Probiotical and distributed via online and retail channels.

products.name: XACIATO (clindamycin phosphate) Vaginal Gel
products.description: An FDA-approved, single-dose prescription vaginal gel for the treatment of bacterial vaginosis, manufactured and commercialized by Organon under license, distributed nationwide in the U.S.

products.name: Ovaprene Hormone-Free Monthly Contraceptive
products.description: An investigational, hormone-free, monthly intravaginal contraceptive ring combining a physical polymer barrier and non-hormonal agent, self-administered and under pivotal Phase 3 clinical study.

products.name: Sildenafil Cream, 3.6% for Female Sexual Arousal Disorder
products.description: A proprietary topical cream formulation of sildenafil for the treatment of female sexual arousal disorder (FSAD), intended for FDA approval and commercial distribution as a prescription drug.

products.name: DARE-HRT1 Intravaginal Ring for Menopausal Hormone Therapy
products.description: A monthly intravaginal ring delivering bio-identical 17β-estradiol and progesterone for menopausal hormone therapy, designed for FDA approval and commercial distribution as a prescription drug.

products.name: DARE-HPV Vaginal Insert for HPV Infection
products.description: A proprietary vaginal insert containing lopinavir and ritonavir for the treatment of persistent high-risk HPV infection and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia, developed as a non-surgical, self-administered therapy.

products.name: DARE-VVA1 Tamoxifen Vaginal Capsule
products.description: A proprietary, hormone-free, intravaginal soft gelatin capsule containing tamoxifen for the treatment of moderate-to-severe dyspareunia (pain during intercourse) associated with genitourinary syndrome of menopause.

products.name: DARE-PDM1 Vaginal Diclofenac Hydrogel
products.description: A proprietary hydrogel formulation of diclofenac for vaginal administration, designed to treat primary dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), offering a novel, non-oral NSAID delivery method.

products.name: DARE-204 and DARE-214 Injectable Contraceptives
products.description: Subcutaneous injectable formulations of etonogestrel designed to provide contraception over 6-month and 12-month periods, intended as longer-acting, reversible methods with predictable return to fertility.

products.name: DARE-FRT1 and DARE-PTB1 Progesterone Intravaginal Rings
products.description: Intravaginal rings designed to release bio-identical progesterone for up to 14 days, developed for luteal phase support in IVF (DARE-FRT1) and prevention of preterm birth (DARE-PTB1).

products.name: Casea S Biodegradable Contraceptive Implant
products.description: A biodegradable contraceptive implant designed to release etonogestrel for 18-24 months before dissolving, providing long-acting contraception without requiring surgical removal.

products.name: DARE-LARC1 User-Controlled Contraceptive Implant
products.description: A user-controlled, long-acting reversible contraceptive implant designed to deliver levonorgestrel over years, allowing the user to pause and resume release as desired.

products.name: Broad-Spectrum Antiviral NV-387
products.description: A nanoviricide-based antiviral drug developed using nanomedicine technology, designed to mimic host cell receptors and dismantle a wide range of viruses. NV-387 is formulated for multiple routes of administration, including oral gummies, oral syrup, injectable solution, and inhalation, and is produced in cGMP-compliant manufacturing facilities. It is being developed for indications such as MPox, Smallpox (biodefense), Measles, Influenza, RSV, Coronaviruses, and viral acute/severe acute respiratory infections.

products.name: HerpeCide Program (NV-HHV-1 and related candidates)
products.description: A family of nanoviricide-based antiviral drugs targeting herpesviruses, including Varicella Zoster Virus (VZV), HSV-1, and HSV-2. The lead candidate, NV-HHV-1, is formulated as a topical skin cream for shingles rash, with additional development for cold sores and genital ulcers. Systemic (oral) formulations are also in development for broader herpesvirus infections. These drugs are manufactured using cGMP-compliant processes and are based on mimicking specific viral entry receptors.

products.name: HIVCide Program (NV-HIV-1 and related candidates)
products.description: A nanoviricide-based antiviral drug program targeting HIV/AIDS, designed to mimic the conserved binding sites (CD4 and CCR5) used by HIV to enter cells. The drugs are developed using the nanoviricide platform and have shown strong activity in animal models. Manufacturing is performed in cGMP-compliant facilities.

products.name: DengueCide Program
products.description: A nanoviricide-based antiviral drug program targeting Dengue viruses, developed using the nanoviricide platform technology. The program is in preclinical stages and aims to address viral infections for which there are currently no effective treatments. Manufacturing is planned to be cGMP-compliant.

products.name: Ocular Antiviral Therapies (HerpeCide/EKC)
products.description: Nanoviricide-based topical eye drop formulations targeting viral diseases of the external eye, including ocular herpes keratitis (HSV-1, HSV-2, VZV) and adenoviral epidemic keratoconjunctivitis (EKC). These drugs are designed for local administration to maximize antiviral effect at the site of infection.

products.name: Flavor Systems and Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured and blended flavor systems, natural and synthetic flavors, extracts, essential oils, and taste modulation systems for food, beverage, and personal care industries. Delivered through physical manufacturing and formulation expertise.

products.name: Dehydrated Vegetables and Agricultural Ingredients
products.description: Physically processed and dehydrated garlic, onion, chili peppers, paprika, parsley, and other vegetables for use as food ingredients and for repackaging under private labels. Delivered via agricultural sourcing and dehydration manufacturing.

products.name: Natural and Synthetic Food and Beverage Colors
products.description: Manufactured natural and synthetic color systems, including certified food colors, for use in foods, beverages, bakery, processed foods, confections, and pet foods. Produced using advanced process technology and global supply chain.

products.name: Personal Care Colors and Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured colors, pigments, and specialty ingredients for personal care products, including cosmetics and personal hygiene items. Delivered through specialized formulation and manufacturing processes.

products.name: Pharmaceutical and Nutraceutical Colors and Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured natural and synthetic colors, excipients, coatings, and specialty ingredients for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical applications. Delivered through regulated manufacturing and formulation expertise.

products.name: Technical and Specialty Colors, Dyes, and Pigments
products.description: Manufactured technical and specialty colors, dyes, and pigments for industrial applications such as paper, plastics, leather, wood stains, antifreeze, and landscaping. Produced using chemical synthesis and specialized processing.

products.name: Laundry Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed laundry detergents, fabric softener sheets, and related products under brands such as ARM & HAMMER, OXICLEAN, and XTRA, distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Household Cleaning and Deodorizing Products
products.description: Produced and sold a range of household cleaning solutions, stain removers, carpet deodorizers, and refrigerator deodorizers, primarily baking soda-based, under brands like ARM & HAMMER, OXICLEAN, CLEAN SHOWER, and ORANGE GLO, distributed via mass retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Cat Litter Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed baking soda-based cat litter products under the ARM & HAMMER brand, distributed through pet and mass retail channels.

products.name: Oral Care Products
products.description: Developed, manufactured, and marketed oral care products including toothpaste, mouthwash, oral analgesics, and water flossers under brands such as ARM & HAMMER, WATERPIK, THERABREATH, and ORAJEL, sold through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Personal Care and Hygiene Products
products.description: Produced and marketed a broad range of personal care products including antiperspirants, deodorants, dry shampoo, depilatories, hand sanitizers, acne treatments, and hair fiber cosmetics under brands such as ARRID, ARM & HAMMER, BATISTE, NAIR, TOUCHLAND, HERO, and TOPPIK.

products.name: Reproductive and Women's Health Products
products.description: Manufactured and sold reproductive health products including condoms, lubricants, vibrators, home pregnancy and ovulation test kits, and feminine hygiene products under brands such as TROJAN, FIRST RESPONSE, and FEMFRESH, distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: OTC Health and Wellness Products
products.description: Produced and marketed over-the-counter health products including cold shortening and relief, nasal saline moisturizers, anti-nauseant, topical analgesics, and hemorrhoid medications under brands such as ZICAM, SIMPLY SALINE, GRAVOL, RUB-A535, and ANUSOL.

products.name: Dietary Supplements and Hair Health Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed dietary supplements and hair health products, including supplements for thinning hair and hair fiber cosmetics, under brands such as VIVISCAL and TOPPIK, distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Animal Nutrition Products
products.description: Produced and sold nutritional supplements, feed additives, prebiotics, and probiotics for dairy cows and other livestock under brands such as ARM & HAMMER, BIO-CHLOR, FERMENTEN, CELMANAX, and CERTILLUS, distributed to livestock producers and industrial customers.

products.name: Specialty Chemicals
products.description: Manufactured and marketed sodium bicarbonate and potassium carbonate/bicarbonate in various grades for industrial, pharmaceutical, food, and agricultural applications, sold to manufacturing companies and industrial customers.

products.name: Commercial and Professional Cleaning Products
products.description: Produced and sold cleaning and deodorizing products for commercial and industrial applications such as office buildings, hotels, and restaurants, distributed through dedicated sales force and distributors.

products.name: Multifamily Property Rental and Management
products.description: Ownership, leasing, and management of multifamily apartment properties, including development and construction of new properties. Properties are physically constructed and managed by third-party or affiliated management companies, with services including rental of apartments and tenant amenities such as parking and storage.

products.name: Commercial Property Rental and Management
products.description: Ownership, leasing, and management of commercial office properties, including rental of office space and related tenant services such as parking and storage. Properties are physically owned and managed by third-party or affiliated management companies.

products.name: Land Investment and Sales
products.description: Acquisition, holding, development, and sale of developed and undeveloped land, including single-family lots. Land is held for appreciation, future development, or sold to third parties.

products.name: Mortgage Notes Receivable Investment
products.description: Investment in mortgage notes receivable, including loans collateralized by land and multifamily properties. These are financial assets rather than physical products, and may include seller-financed notes when properties are sold.

products.name: Inspire System (Neurostimulation Therapy for Obstructive Sleep Apnea)
products.description: A proprietary, minimally invasive, closed-loop neurostimulation system implanted in patients to treat moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) by delivering mild hypoglossal nerve stimulation during sleep. The system includes implantable components (neurostimulator, stimulation lead, and, depending on version, a sensing lead), a patient remote control, and is activated and managed through outpatient surgical procedures and follow-up care. Manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold to hospitals and ambulatory surgery centers, as well as through distributors internationally.

products.name: SleepSync Platform and Inspire Sleep App (Digital Patient Management Tools)
products.description: A cloud-based digital platform and mobile app suite that enables remote monitoring, compliance tracking, and coordinated care management for patients and physicians using the Inspire system. The platform allows physicians to monitor patient compliance and outcomes, and patients to manage their therapy and access educational resources. Delivered as digital-only software and integrated with the Inspire system and patient remote controls.

products.name: Practice Management Software, Revenue Cycle Management, and Patient Relationship Management Solutions
products.description: Digital software solutions provided to dental and medical practices, including practice management, revenue cycle management, and patient relationship management, delivered as software products and platforms.

products.name: Dental and Medical Distribution Services
products.description: Physical distribution of dental and medical products to customers, involving logistics, warehousing, and supply chain management, primarily serving North American and European markets.

products.name: Crude Oil Midstream Services
products.description: Integrated gathering, transportation (via pipelines, trucks, rail, and barges), terminalling, storage, and related logistics services for crude oil, primarily in the United States and Canada. Services are provided through a large-scale, interconnected asset base including pipelines, terminals, storage tanks, marine facilities, rail terminals, and trucking fleets. Revenue is generated through tariffs, transportation fees, storage and throughput fees, and merchant activities involving the purchase, movement, and sale of crude oil.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Midstream Services (U.S. only, post-divestiture)
products.description: Storage and terminalling services for NGLs (ethane, propane, butane, natural gasoline) in the Southwestern United States, including fee-based storage and terminalling for third-party customers and merchant activities involving the transport, storage, and sale of specification NGL products. Assets include NGL storage facilities and related infrastructure.

products.name: Canadian NGL Midstream Services (held for sale/discontinued operations)
products.description: Integrated natural gas processing, NGL fractionation, storage, transportation, and terminalling services in Canada, including merchant activities such as acquisition of extraction rights, processing, fractionation, storage, and sale of NGL products. Assets include gas processing plants, fractionation plants, storage facilities, pipelines, rail terminals, and related infrastructure. This business is being divested and classified as discontinued operations.

products.name: Plumbing Products
products.description: A wide range of plumbing products including faucets, showerheads, valves, bath hardware, bathing units, shower bases, enclosures, water filtration systems, sinks, and kitchen accessories, manufactured or sourced and sold primarily through retailers, wholesalers, and distributors. Production involves physical manufacturing in North America, Europe, and Asia, as well as sourcing from Asia and other regions.

products.name: Spas, Exercise Pools, Aquatic Fitness Systems and Saunas
products.description: Manufactures and sells spas, exercise pools, aquatic fitness systems, and saunas under various brands, distributed worldwide through specialty retailers, distributors, online mass merchandisers, and direct-to-consumer channels. Production requires physical manufacturing and global distribution.

products.name: Plumbing System Components and Non-Decorative Plumbing Products
products.description: Produces and sells brass, copper, and composite plumbing system components and other non-decorative plumbing products to wholesalers, retailers, and building supply outlets, primarily in North America. These are manufactured or sourced and marketed under various brands and private labels.

products.name: Connected Water Products
products.description: Develops and sells connected water systems that provide touchless and voice activation, controlled volume dispensing, and monitoring and control of water temperature and flow, compatible with various faucets and showering components. These are digital-enabled products integrated into plumbing hardware.

products.name: Electron Beam Irradiation Services and Custom Thermoplastic Solutions
products.description: Provides electron beam irradiation services and supplies custom thermoplastic solutions, extruded plastic profiles, specialized fabrications, and PEX tubing to manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers for use in faucets, plumbing supplies, appliances, and building products. This involves specialized manufacturing and B2B services.

products.name: Architectural Coatings
products.description: Manufactures and sells architectural coatings including paints, primers, specialty coatings, stains, and waterproofing products, as well as paint applicators and accessories, primarily in North and South America. Products are sold through home center retailers and other channels, with manufacturing requiring chemical processing and blending.

products.name: Decorative and Functional Hardware
products.description: Produces and sells branded cabinet and door hardware, functional hardware, hook and hook rail products, outdoor living hardware, and decorative bath hardware and shower accessories. These are manufactured and sold to retailers, OEMs, and wholesalers, requiring physical manufacturing and distribution.
